say:2:1230515001:1.text: Because Rustport isn't big enough for two gangs!
say:2:1230515001:1.source_cn: 因为一座锈锚港里容不下两家帮派！
say:2:1230515001:1.male: Because Rustport isn't big enough for two gangs!
say:2:1230515001:1.female: Because Rustport isn't big enough for two gangs!

say:3:1230515002:1.text: We've been at each other's throats for the longest time now.
say:3:1230515002:1.source_cn: 从很久之前，我们两家帮派就一直摩擦不断。
say:3:1230515002:1.male: We've been at each other's throats for the longest time now.
say:3:1230515002:1.female: We've been at each other's throats for the longest time now.

say:4:1230515003:1.text: Those posy parrots have always looked down on the Water Wights like we're scum.
say:4:1230515003:1.source_cn: 那些粉毛鹦鹉一直瞧不起我们水鬼帮，总说我们粗鲁。
say:4:1230515003:1.male: Those posy parrots have always looked down on the Water Wights like we're scum.
say:4:1230515003:1.female: Those posy parrots have always looked down on the Water Wights like we're scum.

say:5:1230515004:1.text: Think they'll cast old grudges out to sea? Fat chance!
say:5:1230515004:1.source_cn: 指望他们放弃前嫌？谁信呢！
say:5:1230515004:1.male: Think they'll cast old grudges out to sea? Fat chance!
say:5:1230515004:1.female: Think they'll cast old grudges out to sea? Fat chance!
